title: Stop testing RewardSaveNoTrack/RewardSaveDuplicateThreshold — both sealed variants are unreachable post-DEC-32/GA-3
rule: TQ-8 (tests must exercise the branch they claim) / Fowler speculative generality

evidence.quote:
// Manually inject a track into the state so setGlobalReward respects
      // the parameter. We can do this by mutating state via the notifier's
test('returns empty list when per-track mode but no track selected', () async {

why: reward_config_controller.dart's bootstrap() hardcodes `tracks: const []` (comment: 'the form is always global and no track list is loaded'), so RewardForm.usesGlobalLadder is always true and the per-track/no-track-selected code in saveReward() is unreachable; separately, GA-3 removed the duplicate-threshold rejection entirely ('the old RewardSaveDuplicateThreshold result is no longer returned'). Despite that, 3 tests in reward_config_controller_test.dart claim to cover 'allows non-global when tracks is non-empty', 'per-track mode but no track selected', and 'RewardSaveNoTrack' but either exercise the identical tracks-empty branch under a different name or never call saveReward() at all (they assert on a hand-built RewardForm instead); a 4th test in reward_configuration_screen_l1_test.dart renders UI for a RewardSaveDuplicateThreshold result the real controller can never produce. A future revert or refactor that mangles these dead branches would ship with zero real regression coverage despite the suite appearing to test exactly that.
recommendation: Remove the dead tracks/selectedTrackId/RewardSaveNoTrack/RewardSaveDuplicateThreshold machinery (and the screen's switch arm for it) now that DEC-32/GA-3 are final, deleting these 4 tests with it; or if per-track rewards are coming back, rewrite the tests to actually seed RewardForm.tracks through a real bootstrap path.
acceptance_criteria: `grep -rn "RewardSaveNoTrack\|RewardSaveDuplicateThreshold" lib/` returns no hits after cleanup, or a new test drives RewardForm.tracks non-empty via the real controller and asserts the branch.
No test in reward_config_controller_test.dart asserts on a hand-constructed RewardForm as a substitute for calling the notifier method the test's group() claims to cover.

corrections: Quote 'isGlobalReward: false,\n selectedTrackId: null,' cited at line 956; actual file has 'const form = RewardForm(' at 956 and the quoted fields at 959-960. Text is verbatim correct just a few lines later than cited.
